messages.text: Anyone else seeing this? I'm finding references with journal names that don't exist. Do we log this separately? (task ref RP-7811)
Is the reference unfindable, or does it point to a real but different source? Could you preserve the reference string before the task disappears from the queue?

Keep the source string and a lookup result with the flag; QA still needs to distinguish fabricated references from broken links. A mismatched DOI is not the same problem as an unreachable journal website.
